name: Fake Azure Arcology
original_name: フェイクアズール・アーコロジー
source:
The Earth was hit by 5 meteors 500 years, sending humans underground, underwater or in buildings called “arcology”. However, humans soon forgot how things were like outside of the utopia they lived in. Chihiro lives in Amahara, an arcology built on the land previously known as Japan. He had a passion for ‘flight’ motorsports and trained hard to be like his idol. But his idol died in an accident, and he lost his goal in life. Then one day, a ‘flight’ broke the walls surrounding Amahara, crashed to the ground in front of him and out stepped a golden-haired girl.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/12/03/december-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
五百年前，五颗陨石撞击地球，迫使人类迁往地下、水下，或住进名为"生态建筑"的设施。然而，人类很快便忘记了自己居住的乌托邦之外曾是什么模样。千寻生活在天原——一座建于昔日日本土地上的生态建筑。他热爱"飞行"竞速运动，为了成为偶像那样的人而刻苦训练。可是，偶像在事故中去世，他也失去了人生目标。一天，一台"飞行器"撞破环绕天原的高墙，坠落在他面前，一名金发女孩从中走了出来。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/12/03/december-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
